description: Defines a reference counting implementation with classes for managing object lifetime via atomic reference counts, including a base class 'QuicheReferenceCountedImpl' and a smart pointer template 'QuicheReferenceCountedPointerImpl'.

classes.name: QuicheReferenceCountedImpl
classes.description: A base class implementing thread-safe reference counting with atomic operations, used for managing object lifetime.

classes.name: QuicheReferenceCountedPointerImpl
classes.description: A template smart pointer class that manages reference counting for objects derived from QuicheReferenceCountedImpl.

methods.name: AddReference
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the object.

methods.name: RemoveReference
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and indicates if the object should be deleted.

methods.name: HasUniqueReference
methods.description: Checks if the object has exactly one reference.

methods.name: AssignObject
methods.description: Assigns a new object to the smart pointer, managing reference counts appropriately.
